quiz.question: Which three color channels combine to make every color on your screen?
quiz.explanation: Screens use the RGB model: red, green, and blue light mixed at different strengths. Combining these three channels can produce over 16 million distinct colors.

quiz.question: What range of values does each color channel use?
quiz.explanation: Each channel ranges from 0 to 255, which fits exactly in one byte (8 bits). That gives 256 possible intensity levels per channel.

quiz.question: Which RGB values represent pure white?
quiz.explanation: White is all three channels at maximum intensity: (255, 255, 255). Black is the opposite, (0, 0, 0), where all channels are off.
